title: Pea Plant Shiraz - Mini Plug Plants - x3 Purple Mangetout/Snow Pea - Hardy
description:
Pea Plant: Purple Mangetout/Snow Pea ‘Shiraz’ (Mini Plug Plants) x3


 Set of 3 mini plug plants of British-bred mangetout (snow pea) ‘Shiraz’. Produces bright purple pods and attractive bi-coloured flowers. Pods are best harvested young and sweet and can be eaten raw, lightly steamed, or added to stir-fries. Pods contain anthocyanin (antioxidant) pigments; the purple colour typically fades to dark green when steamed or fried.


 Plant height (approx.)


  Up to 100 cm
 

 Growing notes


  Plant out once established and conditions are suitable
 

  Grow in a sunny position in moist, fertile, well-drained soil
 

  Keep weed-free and water as needed
 

  Provide support as the plants grow
 

  Harvest when pods begin to swell, and pick regularly to encourage continued cropping
 

 What you’ll receive


  3 x mini plug plants
